title: Phantom 320 kcal meal auto-appears on app open
context: Multiple internal testers report: opening the app they find a logged meal with ~320 kcal they never logged. This is the #1 trust bug. Do not blame the user in any copy.
tasks: Audit every auto-log path: PendingMealScanQueue drain, smart-next suggestions, demo/seed data, leftover debug code, sync retries, widget deep-links
Add a one-time cleanup migration in Hive that removes meals older than X with no user confirmation (only seeds/demos), logged with console tag
Any auto-created entry must require explicit user tap to confirm — never silently added to day log
Add regression test: fresh install -> open home -> day log must be empty
